items.title: Nasdaq (NDAQ) Completed the Dasseti Acquisition to Deepen eVestment’s Private-Market Capabilities
items.summary: Nasdaq, Inc. (NASDAQ:NDAQ) completed the acquisition of Dasseti, an artificial intelligence-powered platform for due diligence and ongoing monitoring across public and private markets. items.summary: Nasdaq completed its acquisition of Dasseti on September 2, adding an AI-assisted due-diligence and monitoring platform to Nasdaq eVestment.
